conditions.evidence: clinical stage IIB/III non-small cell lung carcinoma
conditions.label: non-small cell lung carcinoma

modalities.evidence: FDG-PET imaging both pre- and post-chemoradiotherapy

output.population: Patients older than 18 years with AJCC-criteria clinical stage IIB/III non-small cell lung carcinoma planned for definitive concurrent chemoradiotherapy (inoperable disease).
output.summary: Multicenter ACRIN 6668 trial collection with FDG-PET imaging before and after chemoradiotherapy in locally advanced non-small cell lung carcinoma, testing whether post-treatment standardized uptake value predicts long-term survival.
